# Project AI Instructions

Before starting any task in this repository, read the files under `.ai/` first.

## Required entry point

1. Start with `.ai/project.md`.
2. Follow every file referenced from `.ai/project.md` before making changes.
3. Treat rules defined under `.ai/` as the highest-priority project instructions for this repository.

## Working rule

Do not begin implementation, refactoring, or review work until the relevant `.ai/` guidance has been checked.
When instructions conflict, prefer the rules defined in `.ai/` for this repository.
